There is no Lucid 0.1.3. Its release stopped at a check of how the source code is formatted, before anything was published. A release tag is never moved to other code, so the fix got a new version: 0.1.4 is what 0.1.3 would have been. The tag `v0.1.3` exists, but has no release; use `v0.1.4` instead.

Lucid itself and its settings are unchanged. The Nix flake now pins a newer NixOS 26.05, but builds Lucid with the same Go 1.26.10 and the same dependencies as before. The archives, packages and container image are built with Go 1.26.11, as in 0.1.2.

## Known issues

The Nix package is still built with Go 1.26.10, because NixOS 26.05 does not have Go 1.26.11 yet, so it still lacks the fix for [GO-2026-6859](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6859) that 0.1.2 brought to the other builds. A later release brings it to Nix once NixOS has it.

## Upgrading

A deb, rpm or Arch package of 0.1.4 installs over 0.1.2 and restarts a running service. The container image is `0.1.4` or `latest`. With Nix, `nix flake update` brings 0.1.4 if you follow `github:tbckr/lucid/stable`; if you use a release tag, switch to `github:tbckr/lucid/v0.1.4`.
